name: Start page lists all four assessments with metadata and actions
description: The Start page server-renders a hero heading and a grid of exactly four assessment cards, each showing its short name, duration, question count, a 'Learn more' link, and a 'Start' button. A first assertion on the hero heading forces the checker onto /start (not the Home page).

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Start page at /start
Verify the page hero heading reads exactly 'Pick an assessment to start with.' — this confirms the browser is on the Start page and not the Home page.

Verify exactly four assessment cards are shown below the hero. Each card must show a short name as a heading — Solstice, Turing, Pride, and Passage, one per card — and directly beneath each heading a single meta line containing both a duration ending in 'min' and a question count containing the word 'questions' (for example '~10 min · 36 questions'). Confirm all four cards have such a meta line, and that each card also has a 'Learn more' link and a 'Start' button.
